consultationPage.metadataDescription: Book a paid Brazil immigration strategy consultation and receive a personalized roadmap for visas, residency, compliance, and next steps.
consultationPage.heroSubtitle: Receive a personalized roadmap for your move to Brazil based on your goals, background, and legal options.
includesItems: Eligibility evaluation for Brazilian visas and residency pathways.
Custom immigration strategy for your profile and timeline.
Document preparation guidance and evidence planning.
Expected timelines, procedural milestones, and filing order.
Legal considerations, risk points, and compliance safeguards.
whoItems: People planning to move to Brazil soon or in the next 12 months.
Investors exploring residency routes linked to investment activity.
Families relocating and planning school, housing, and legal status.
Digital nomads and remote professionals seeking compliant status.
Retirees and professionals who want legal certainty before moving.
whyItems: Avoid costly mistakes before filing or booking travel.
Understand the strongest visa or residency options for your case.
Receive personalized legal guidance instead of generic information.
Prepare your documents correctly from the beginning.
consultationPage.formIntro: Complete this form so we can prepare your strategy session efficiently.
consultationPage.successMessage: Consultation request submitted successfully. We will contact you shortly with next steps.
consultationPage.errorMessage: We could not submit your request right now. Please try again shortly.
consultationPage.paymentGateBody: Consultation payment is required before selecting an appointment slot in Calendly.
bookingFlowSteps: After booking, the client receives an email confirmation automatically from Calendly.
consultationPage.calendlyTitle: Book your paid consultation in Calendly

consultationPage.docReminderBody: Please submit any relevant documents before your consultation if you want the consultation to be effective and personalized.

consultationPage.docFormSuccessMessage: Documents submitted successfully. Thank you for sending them in advance.
consultationPage.docFormErrorMessage: We could not submit your documents right now. Please try again shortly.
consultationPage.whatsappBody: If you have questions about the consultation or payment process, please contact us directly via WhatsApp.

clientPortalPage.metadataDescription: Client portal for document upload, intake forms, payment instructions, scheduling, and emergency support channels.
clientPortalPage.heroSubtitle: Use this secure portal to upload documents, submit intake information, complete payment, and book your consultation.
clientPortalPage.uploadSubtitle: Upload your documents clearly and securely so our team can prepare your case file before consultation.
clientPortalPage.formsSubtitle: Fill out your intake details and required information related to your immigration process.
clientPortalPage.formsSuccess: Client form submitted successfully. We will review it shortly.
clientPortalPage.bookingIntro: Clients can book only after payment. Appointments must be at least 36 hours after payment confirmation.
bookingSteps: After booking, client receives an appointment confirmation email.
clientPortalPage.whatsappHelp: If anything is unclear or you need assistance booking your consultation, please contact us directly on WhatsApp.
clientPortalPage.reminderWarning: Please submit any relevant documents before your consultation if you want the consultation to be effective and personalized. Documents submitted after the consultation may limit our ability to provide detailed guidance.
clientPortalPage.emergencyMessage: In case of emergency please contact us via WhatsApp and clearly state the nature of your emergency. For regular clients, you already have an assigned attorney or consultant. Please contact them directly.
clientPortalPage.error: We could not submit your request right now. Please try again shortly.

bookStrategyConsultationPage.metadataDescription: Book a paid strategy consultation for your Brazil immigration plan and receive clear next steps based on your profile and timeline.
bookStrategyConsultationPage.title: Book Strategy Consultation
bookStrategyConsultationPage.subtitle: This paid consultation gives you a concrete legal strategy for moving to Brazil with confidence and reduced risk.
benefits: Profile-based visa and residency pathway analysis.
Priority action plan for documents and legal steps.
Timeline guidance with risk and compliance checkpoints.
Clear recommendation on what to do first and what to avoid.
deliverables: A practical roadmap tailored to your immigration objective.
Guidance on required documents and evidence quality.
A realistic sequence for filings, travel, and deadlines.
Follow-up direction for execution after the strategy call.
bookStrategyConsultationPage.formSubtitle: Complete the form below and our team will follow up with payment and scheduling instructions.
bookStrategyConsultationPage.success: Request sent successfully. We will contact you with next steps shortly.
bookStrategyConsultationPage.error: We could not submit your request right now. Please try again shortly.

emailUsNoticePage.metadataDescription: Submit an official notice request with supporting details so our team can review and respond promptly.
emailUsNoticePage.title: Email Us Notice
emailUsNoticePage.subtitle: Use this page to send a formal notice to our team. Include complete details so we can route your request correctly and reply quickly.
howItWorks: Submit your notice with complete identifying details.
Our team reviews urgency, scope, and required legal follow-up.
You receive a confirmation response by email.
emailUsNoticePage.formSubtitle: All fields are accessible and optimized for desktop/mobile.
emailUsNoticePage.success: Notice submitted successfully. We will respond by email soon.
emailUsNoticePage.error: We could not submit your notice right now. Please try again shortly.

paymentMethods.title: Payments
paymentMethods.subtitle: Pay your consultation fee using any method below. Send confirmation to our WhatsApp or email after payment.

methods.label: PayPal
methods.instructions: Use PayPal transfer and set the receiver email below in the payment form.

methods.label: Wise
methods.instructions: Send through Wise to the same receiver email. Add your full name in the transfer note.

methods.label: PIX
methods.instructions: Use PIX transfer with the receiver email key and keep your receipt for booking confirmation.

methods.label: Payoneer
methods.instructions: Use Payoneer transfer to the receiver email and share proof of payment with our team.

calendlyEmbed.description: Book your appointment only after payment. Appointments must be scheduled at least 36 hours after payment confirmation.
